fact: The Djanta Tech Hub, a 3000 m2 centre for incubation, acceleration and mentoring of tech startups, was inaugurated in Lomé on 7 May 2026 with the Idée-Action and Innov'Action programmes, and earlier hubs exist including Nunya Lab (Lomé), Banm Lab (Dapaong) and Tilitu Lab (Kara).
title: Djanta Tech Hub : le Togo lance son premier hub technologique
